newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: EU applauds Sierra Leone on peace agreement.
newsitem.headline: EU applauds Sierra Leone on peace agreement.

text.p: The European Union on Monday congratulated the government of Sierra Leone on the signing of a peace agreement to end the country's civil war.

The Sierra Leone government and rebels signed a comprehensive peace accord at a public ceremony in the Ivory Coast on Saturday to end almost six years of civil war that have killed at least 10,000 people.
President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah shook hands and embraced Foday Sankoh, leader of the Revolutionary United Front (RUF), after they signed the accord witnessed by Ivorian President Henri Konan Bedie.
The EU said in a statement that the accord would not have been possible without "the determined and unceasing efforts of those concerned both inside and outside Sierra Leone to bring about peace."

"The Union hopes most sincerely that this agreement will bring to an end the suffering endured by Sierra Leone during the civil conflict and enable it to look forward to a peaceful and prosperous future," the EU said.
